search_window.basis: Since completed_at of latest verified Food Line hourly heartbeat; reviewed publication and incident dates, not crawler freshness.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall watch; national production collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster involving a community's only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store

Abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major reduction in access

failures.error: Direct source request timed out; no claim of fully checked Guam DPHSS coverage.

observations: Wisconsin FoodShare member news and Virginia DSS alerts showed no demonstrably new in-window immediate benefit interruption.
Hawaii BESSD call-center/application delays were existing and not newly dated in the interval.
California CalFresh landing page contained standing program resources, not a newly dated interruption.
Feeding America West Michigan mobile distribution schedule remained an undated dynamic listing; no new in-window, cause-qualified cancellation verified.
Community Action Services and Food Bank in Provo officially confirms its closure effective Nov 1, 2026, predating the recall window.
Guam DPHSS failed to load; remaining news and agency checks gave useful but not exhaustive coverage.
Search returned older grocery fires and closures, prior 2025 SNAP shutdown notices, September storm-related closures, donation appeals, and irrelevant routine listings.

reviewed_exclusions.reason: Provider confirms Nov 1, 2026 closure; known event predates hourly recall interval.
Only-store fire occurred Sept 11, 2026; not new.
Storm-related food bank closure occurred Sept 25, 2026; not new.
Dynamic schedule alone does not establish new posting or disaster-caused cancellation within the interval.
2025 benefit disruption not a new November 2026 official interruption.
Donation appeal and supply concern, without verified abrupt service cessation.

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Excluded donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, routine program promotion, generic inflation, previously observed incidents, future threats without realized disruption, and out-of-window events.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new qualifying incident could be substantiated in the hourly window. One direct agency page failed by timeout, so coverage is DEGRADED but the limitation is nonmaterial given 12 successful searches and six successful direct checks. Not a claim of exhaustive nationwide absence.
